baseline.definition: equal-weight normalized uncertainty and global distance

cauchy_evidence.definition: Cauchy combination of conflict and tree disagreement tails

cauchy_modality_support.definition: Cauchy combination of global distance and every modality-specific KNN tail

max_modality_knn.definition: maximum tail risk across modality-specific KNN components

modality_support_union.definition: Bonferroni union of global distance and every modality-specific KNN tail

selected_pairwise_endpoint.definition: the frozen Pairwise report selected without unknown or test labels in each scenario

support_union.definition: Bonferroni union of global distance and global KNN tail
